selection: All newly added source/expected fixture pairs in tests/fixtures/optimizer/simplify.sql at each fix relative to its exact parent. No filtering on generator outcomes.
adapter: Text-only SELECT (<unchanged expression>) AS result FROM regression_input, with alphabetical union of original/fixed/parent identifiers as nullable INTEGER columns, no domain/key/FK constraints. Preserve all internal operators, literals, and parentheses. No SQLite transpilation or function rewriting.
exclusions: Unsupported SQLite functions/syntax, non-INTEGER variable type ambiguity, and duplicate unordered normalized pairs are retained in the complete pool and ledger. No easy-case rewriting. Detection and control admission are separate.

oracle.implementation: Python standard-library sqlite3, independent of all QueryWitness imports and of SQLGlot SQL generation
oracle.domain_freeze: This protocol is hashed before any cohort SQLite diagnostic execution. Same domain for every INTEGER input column.
oracle.instances: Empty table, exhaustive singleton Cartesian product of the diagnostic domain over every declared column; first discrepancy repeated twice and as an eight-row duplicate bag; reverse insertion replay. Scan every singleton even after a witness.
oracle.result_policy: bag; exact numeric rational comparison, NULL observation equality, distinct TEXT/BLOB tags; column count also compared
oracle.nonfinite_or_execution_error: inconclusive; retain errors and never count as a mismatch
oracle.interpretation: One successful singleton mismatch is a row8 witness. No mismatch on the diagnostic domain is unresolved, not equivalence. Source/fixed pairs are intended controls, not assumed true controls. Contradicted controls are retained and labeled.

requirements: Same pinned QueryWitness 0.2 implementation, parser and complete existing guard/limits
No generator tuning or supplied diagnostic domains
Retain every scheduled trial, including post-first-witness trials
Record effective pools, generated rows, execution errors, both-empty outcomes and elapsed times
Independently replay each reported witness and reverse insertion order using this checker
Report denominators at fixture/pair and three upstream bug-cluster levels; permutations and repeat seeds are not independent bugs
Report unresolved/unsupported/control-contradicted pairs separately without pruning the frozen pool

limitations: Regression-derived bounded cohort, not blinded or organizationally independent
SQLGlot also supplies QueryWitness's parser (version 27.29.0), creating shared-parser coupling
Selection motivated by source-visible fixed bugs; no population recall or generalization estimate
Three upstream bug clusters, not one independent bug per fixture
Restricted INTEGER interpretation, SQLite version and finite diagnostic domain limit conclusions
No QueryWitness generator, search, execution or comparison code is run during this phase
